children.approach: ⊗/+ = D two-sided: ⊗ preserves coproducts in each variable (Day tensor).
children.note: Left-variable iso (P + P') ⊗ Q ≅ (P ⊗ Q) + (P' ⊗ Q) machine-checked 2026-07-17 as Container.dirCoprodDistrib (ContainerIso, both round-trips; sorry-free, Quot.sound only) in lean/Containers/Containers/TensorCoprodDistrib.lean — third Lean cell of the table, sibling of seqCoprodDistrib with ⊗ (product positions) in place of ◁. Both round trips close by a case split on the sum tag + rfl; no transport (coproduct shape is already a Sum). ⊗ is symmetric so the cell is genuinely two-sided; only the left law is formalised (it already witnesses the cell).

children.approach: ×/+ = D two-sided: × preserves coproducts (Cont distributive category).
children.note: Left-variable iso (P + P') × Q ≅ (P × Q) + (P' × Q) machine-checked 2026-07-22 as Container.prodCoprodDistrib (ContainerIso, both round-trips; sorry-free, Quot.sound only) in lean/Containers/Containers/TimesCoprodDistrib.lean — fourth Lean cell of the table, sibling of dirCoprodDistrib/seqCoprodDistrib with × (coproduct positions P s ⊕ Q t) in place of ⊗/◁. Both round trips close by a case split on the sum tag + rfl; no transport (coproduct shape is already a Sum, and each summand's position coproduct matches definitionally). × is symmetric so the cell is genuinely two-sided; only the left law is formalised (it already witnesses the cell). Completes the 'distributes over +' column (◁/+, ⊗/+, ×/+) in Lean.

children.approach: ⊗/◁ = L: Spivak's interchanger (a◁b)⊗(c◁d)→(a⊗c)◁(b⊗d) (Ref eq 29); lax not iso; the one deep non-formal L. Iso-locus and one-directionality = my comparitor coreflection (Thm C) + no-go.
why ⊗/◁ is L not D: comparitor = counit of coreflection ⊗−=Lan_J((◁−)∘J) (2026-07-14 Thm C); double-comonoid obstruction = Eckmann–Hilton (comparitor no-go).
◁/⊗ = –: no natural (a⊗b)◁(c⊗d)→(a◁c)⊗(b◁d). Factorization/naturality obstruction (joint g:a[i]×b[j]→S_c×S_d does not split into independent h,k). = no natural section of the coreflection counit.

×/⊗ = – (CORRECTION; Hedges has L). Proof: witness (1,y,y,1) forces impossible morphism 1→y. The genuine ⊗–× interchanger is ⊗/× (⊗ outer, × inner; S–S Ex 2.2 dual, pair-into-product), formal & never iso. Transposition in Hedges' grid.
